name: Thư hoa (Flower Letter)
notes: A pink envelope stands up on the card, its heart seal beats and opens, three carnations bloom out of it with baby's breath and butterflies, and a note slides up with the card's words (slot "board"). Stop 1: a polaroid of the card's photo pops up beside the bouquet. Everything is built in scene.js; the only files are the handwriting face (fonts/, Dancing Script, OFL) and the card's own photo.
